name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 101 - Am 7
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 101a. Emphasises that electoral law and the organisation of elections remain within the competences of the Member States; stresses that EU action must respect national constitutional frameworks and democratic choices; calls for appropriate representation of opposition parties, or their participation as observers, in structures dealing with democratic governance; asserts that the European Democracy Shield’s initiatives must not, in themselves, constitute a risk of interference;
